# HOLD

> The provably cheapest film shooting order, and a legality verdict for every day a child
> performer is on set, with the sentence from the statute on screen.

HOLD takes a scene list, who is in each scene, the shooting days and the rate tier. A CP-SAT model
assigns scenes to days to minimise the days performers are paid to wait, with child-performer law
and the union agreements as hard constraints, and either proves the optimum or reports the bound
it stopped at. An independent checker then judges every day and names each rule it breaks with the
citation and the verbatim quote from the source.

If you are an agent, you do not have to read this site to use it. It exposes its own MCP server,
and every headline figure is served as JSON by the status endpoint.

## For agents

- [MCP server](https://hold-fwmdq7fc3q-uc.a.run.app/mcp/): streamable HTTP. Four tools:
  `solve_schedule` (cheapest legal order for a schedule), `check_legality` (one day judged, with
  citations), `lookup_rule` (one rule record with its verbatim quote and source URL), and
  `run_residual` (solve a published academic benchmark instance and compare the cost found to its
  published optimum). Solve time is capped on this transport and each tool states its own cap.
- [Status](https://hold-fwmdq7fc3q-uc.a.run.app/api/status): JSON. Every headline figure, the
  model, the region, the solver version and the streaming state. Nothing on it is typed by hand.
- [OpenAPI](https://hold-fwmdq7fc3q-uc.a.run.app/api/docs): every route with its schema.

## For people

- [The board](https://hold-fwmdq7fc3q-uc.a.run.app/#/board): the stripboard. Press Solve.
- [Judge walkthrough](https://hold-fwmdq7fc3q-uc.a.run.app/#/judge): seven things a stranger can
  check, each one a link.
- [Repository](https://github.com/StephenSook/hold): Apache-2.0, all source and the rule registry.

## Rules and provenance

- [Rule registry](https://github.com/StephenSook/hold/tree/main/rules): 70 records covering
  Georgia and California child-performer law, the SAG-AFTRA young-performer handbook and the low
  budget agreements. Every quote is checked on every push against a committed snapshot of its
  source, and a record whose quote cannot be verified is excluded rather than paraphrased.
- [Claims audit](https://github.com/StephenSook/hold/blob/main/docs/claims-audit.md): every
  technology named on a judge-facing surface, and the file that proves it is called at runtime.

## Notes

The bundled demo schedule is constructed and says so on screen. Nobody has used HOLD on a real
production, and nothing here is legal advice.
